author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 1.0.0 is the first stable release of Presence Manager, combining Hubitat mobile geolocation presence, phone IP checks and Third Party Services switches into one reliable household occupancy status. Highlights: fast-to-Home, conservative-to-Away decision logic with configurable arrival/departure delays; a Presence Report page showing each person's hours home per day over a rolling 90 day window, with CSV export; an optional Location Lookup line reverse-geocoding the hub's coordinates via OpenStreetMap (off by default); Guest Mode; and watchdogs that keep IP checks, Guest Mode expiry and periodic evidence re-evaluation from silently stalling. See the git history for the full development changelog.
